body.content: Hypothesize a 'Diversity Threshold': Is there a mathematical point where the number of distinct implementation stacks in a decentralized network provides a statistical guarantee against any single software bug causing >X% failure? This would move the argument from qualitative ('diversity is good') to quantitative ('N distinct stacks provide Y resilience').
body.why_keep_this: Provides a path to quantify the 'diversity threshold' mentioned in SCR_004.
